start: An owner at the desk of an online gym on a device that was online before; the internet goes down

steps.action: Keep using the panel
user_sees: Bar at the top: 'Offline: nothing waiting to send. No internet. Check-ins, payments and new members are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back. Other things wait. Details shown are from {time}.'
must_not: A sign-out
A blank page

steps.action: Add a new member, sell them a plan and take the payment
user_sees: The member, the plan and a receipt at once, each marked Waiting to send
The receipt number is from this desk’s own offline series
The bar now starts 'Offline:' with the count waiting
must_not: A receipt number another desk can also give
The money missing from the member page

steps.action: Tap 'See what is waiting'
user_sees: A list: what was done, for whom, when; each line Waiting to send
The button now reads 'Hide the list'
must_not: A waiting thing missing from the list
Another gym’s item in the list

steps.action: The internet comes back
user_sees: 'Internet is back. Sending {n} saved on this device…', then 'All sent. Everything saved on this device is now online.'
The Waiting to send marks go
must_not: The member, plan or payment saved twice
A new receipt number given to a receipt that was already printed
The payment sent before the member it belongs to

start: An owner with things the server refused, shown in the bar after the internet is back

steps.action: Read the bar
user_sees: A line per refused thing with the member’s name and the reason, such as 'Not sent: it is more than this member owes now (another device took money for the same plan). It is kept on this device. Ask the owner to check this member.'
Buttons 'Save as cancelled receipt', 'Remove from this device', 'Try sending again'
must_not: Refused money counted in the totals
The refused thing dropped silently

steps.action: Tap 'Save as cancelled receipt'
user_sees: The receipt is in the gym as cancelled, with its printed number; the line leaves the bar
must_not: The receipt counted as income
The printed number lost

steps.action: On another refused thing tap 'Remove from this device'
user_sees: 'Remove it from this device for good? It was never sent, so it will be gone.' with 'Yes, remove it' and 'Keep it'
must_not: Removed at the first tap with no question

steps.action: For a thing waiting because the device clock was ahead, tap 'Send with today's date'
user_sees: It is sent with today’s date and leaves the bar
must_not: A receipt dated in the future saved

start: An owner with payments waiting on this device, on Settings, Sign-in & data

steps.action: Tap 'Clear offline copy'
user_sees: A warning that names what is waiting from this device, including the payments and their amount: 'They are not in your gym’s records yet. Clearing deletes them for good. Everything else in your gym’s records stays safe online.'
must_not: The mild question 'Nothing is deleted from your gym’s records online' while payments are waiting
Waiting payments deleted with no warning

steps.action: Tap 'Keep it'
user_sees: Everything still waiting
must_not: Anything deleted

steps.action: Change a plan price, cancel a receipt or open a page that needs the internet
user_sees: 'No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back.'
Or a page '{name} needs the internet' with 'This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now.'
must_not: The change shown as done
The change put in the waiting list without a word

steps.action: Take a payment on a device that has never been online since it got this version
user_sees: 'Connect this device to the internet once so it can take payments offline. Until then, take this payment when the internet is back.'
must_not: A receipt with a number that may clash
A payment saved with no number

steps.action: Take a second payment from a member whose first one is still waiting
user_sees: 'A payment for this member is still being sent. When the internet is back, check the member's page before you take money again.'
must_not: Two payments for the same dues

steps.action: Take a payment when the device has no room left
user_sees: 'Nothing was saved: this device is out of space. Free up space, or try again when the internet is back.'
must_not: A receipt shown or printed for a payment that was not kept

start: An owner with three things waiting to send, internet still down

steps.action: Close the browser and restart the device, open the panel
user_sees: The same three things, still marked Waiting to send
must_not: The waiting list empty after a restart

steps.action: Open Settings, Staff & sign-in and try to sign out
user_sees: '3 saved on this device are still waiting to send. Wait for "All sent" at the top before you sign out.'; sign-out is not allowed yet
must_not: A sign-out that leaves unsent payments behind without a word

steps.action: The internet comes back; one new member has the same mobile as a member another desk added meanwhile
user_sees: A note: 'Check {name}: {other name} already has the same mobile number. Both are kept.' with 'OK'
must_not: One of the two members merged or dropped
The payments taken for the offline member pointing at nobody

steps.action: Tap 'OK' on the note
user_sees: The note goes
must_not: The note back after a reload

start: An owner signing in on a desk device where a Staff person left unsent payments

steps.action: Sign in to the same gym on that device
user_sees: The waiting payments are sent; each receipt names the Staff person who took the money
must_not: The owner written as taker
The payments shown to someone who signs in to a different gym on this device

steps.action: Someone signs in to another gym on the same device
user_sees: Nothing of the first gym: no waiting list, no names, no amounts
must_not: The first gym’s member names or payments in the bar or the list

start: A Staff person at the front desk of an online gym; the internet goes down during the evening rush

steps.action: Check a member in
user_sees: The check-in shows at once
The bar at the top now starts 'Offline:' with the count waiting, then 'No internet. Check-ins, payments and new members are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back.'
must_not: The check-in refused because there is no internet

steps.action: Take a dues payment from a member
user_sees: A receipt at once with this desk’s own offline receipt number, marked Waiting to send; the receipt names this Staff person
must_not: A receipt with no number
Dues still shown in full

steps.action: Change a member’s phone number
user_sees: The new number at once
must_not: The change lost when the internet returns

steps.action: The internet comes back
user_sees: 'Internet is back. Sending {n} saved on this device…', then 'All sent. Everything saved on this device is now online.'
must_not: Any of the three saved twice
A second check-in for the day if another desk also checked the member in

start: A Staff person with unsent things on the device, on Settings, Staff & sign-in

steps.action: Try to sign out while things are still waiting
user_sees: '{n} saved on this device are still waiting to send. Wait for "All sent" at the top before you sign out.'; sign-out is not allowed yet
must_not: A sign-out with payments left unsent and no word

steps.action: Try to sign out when the only things left were refused by the server
user_sees: '{n} saved on this device could not be sent (see the top of the page). If you sign out, they stay on this device until someone from this gym signs in here again.'; sign-out is allowed
must_not: The refused payments deleted by the sign-out

start: A Staff person whose offline payment the server refuses when the internet is back

steps.action: A payment dated more than 31 days back is sent
user_sees: Bar line: 'Not sent: the payment is more than 31 days old, and the front desk can’t send those. It is kept on this device. Ask the owner to sign in here to send it.'
The receipt is marked Not sent: ask the owner
must_not: The payment dropped
The payment counted in the totals
Buttons to remove it or save it as cancelled shown to Staff

steps.action: A payment bigger than what the member now owes is sent
user_sees: 'Not sent: it is more than this member owes now (another device took money for the same plan). It is kept on this device. Ask the owner to check this member.'
must_not: The member shown as having paid more than the plan costs

steps.action: Try to change a plan price or cancel a receipt with no internet
user_sees: 'No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back.'
must_not: The change queued silently

start: A Staff person who changed a member offline while the owner changed the same member online

steps.action: The internet comes back
user_sees: A field only the desk changed is kept; a field only the owner changed is kept; for a field both changed, the later change wins and the desk gets one line saying which
must_not: The owner’s other changes wiped by the desk’s older copy
No word to the desk that its change lost

steps.action: The member was removed from the gym meanwhile
user_sees: The waiting change for that member is dropped; nothing is sent
must_not: The member brought back by the late change

steps.action: Tap 'Try sending again' when a refused thing is in the bar
user_sees: It is tried again; if still refused it stays with its reason
must_not: A second copy sent
The thing vanishing without being saved

start: A Staff person on a shared desk device with payments waiting, taken by a colleague

steps.action: Sign in on the device the colleague used
user_sees: The colleague’s payments wait for the colleague or an owner to send them, with a line saying so
must_not: The payments sent under this Staff person’s name
The payments lost

steps.action: Look at the bar and the waiting list
user_sees: Names and amounts of this gym only
must_not: Money totals for the gym shown to Staff through the waiting figures of other people

start: A desk device with a new member, a payment for them and a check-in waiting; the internet returns

steps.action: The panel sends what is waiting
user_sees: In the order it was done: the member first, then the payment, then the check-in
Each record keeps the id and the receipt number it was shown and printed with
must_not: A payment sent before its member
A record given a new id or number on the way

steps.action: Everything is taken by the server
user_sees: The waiting list is empty; the desk sees 'All sent. Everything saved on this device is now online.'
must_not: A sent thing left in the list and sent again later

start: A device with things waiting for a gym, signed out; later someone of the same gym signs in on it

steps.action: The sign-in completes
user_sees: The waiting things of that gym are found (they are filed by gym, not by sign-in) and sent
must_not: The waiting list lost by the sign-out or by a key that stopped working
The waiting list of one gym sent into another gym

start: The server refusing a waiting thing for good

steps.action: A payment is refused
user_sees: It is held on the device with a plain reason, shown in the bar, left out of the totals, and tried again on the next start or on Try sending again
must_not: Money dropped
The same refusal retried in a tight loop
Other members’ waiting things blocked behind it

steps.action: A payment dated later than the server’s today arrives (device clock ahead)
user_sees: It waits with 'Not sent yet: its date is later than today on the internet, so this device's clock may be wrong. It goes by itself when that day comes, or an owner can send it with today's date.'
must_not: A receipt dated in the future saved
The payment marked as refused for good

steps.action: The waiting list on the device cannot be read or written
user_sees: No new offline receipt number is given while it cannot be read; the desk is told nothing was saved
must_not: A number given twice
A payment shown that was not kept

start: A waiting thing that is sent twice, or that meets a change made elsewhere

steps.action: The same waiting payment is sent a second time (the first answer was lost)
user_sees: The server answers as before; one payment in the gym
must_not: Two payments

steps.action: A waiting check-in meets a check-in another desk saved for the same member and day
user_sees: Nothing is sent; one visit for the day
must_not: Two visits

steps.action: A waiting new member meets a member with the same mobile saved elsewhere first
user_sees: Both are kept; the late one is marked as a possible duplicate and the desk gets a note
must_not: The two merged
The late one dropped with its payments

steps.action: An online payment whose save got no answer is kept as a waiting push and the page is reloaded
user_sees: It is sent again exactly once with the same id
must_not: It is lost by the reload
It is saved twice

start: The waiting list as kept on a desk device

steps.action: Look at what is stored for the waiting list
user_sees: One list per gym, holding the records the desk made (names, mobiles, amounts) until they are sent
must_not: The sign-in key or a PIN stored with it
A list readable from a sign-in to another gym

steps.action: The owner removes this device or the key stops working
user_sees: The copy of the gym goes; the waiting list stays for the next sign-in of the same gym
must_not: Unsent payments deleted because the device was signed out
